intro: This unit is about geography — area, population and what places are famous for (using Xinjiang as the example). Grammar: (1) saying fractions and percentages (三分之二, 百分之六十); (2) 凡是……都…… “every… / all…”; (3) double negatives (没有不……, 不……不行) for strong positives. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.zh: 它的面积有166万平方公里，相当于意大利的五倍多。
key_sentences.py: Tā de miànjī yǒu yì bǎi liùshíliù wàn píngfāng gōnglǐ, xiāngdāng yú Yìdàlì de wǔ bèi duō.
key_sentences.en: Its area is 1.66 million square kilometres — more than five times the size of Italy.

key_sentences.zh: 新疆的少数民族占人口总数的60%。
key_sentences.py: Xīnjiāng de shǎoshù mínzú zhàn rénkǒu zǒngshù de bǎi fēn zhī liùshí.
key_sentences.en: Ethnic minorities make up 60% of Xinjiang's population.

key_sentences.zh: 新疆有“瓜果之乡”之称，葡萄、西瓜都好吃得不得了。
key_sentences.py: Xīnjiāng yǒu “guāguǒ zhī xiāng” zhī chēng, pútao, xīguā dōu hǎochī de bùdéliǎo.
key_sentences.en: Xinjiang is known as “the home of melons and fruit” — its grapes and watermelons are incredibly delicious.

key_sentences.zh: 凡是去过新疆的人，没有不提到“吃”的。
key_sentences.py: Fánshì qùguo Xīnjiāng de rén, méiyǒu bù tídào “chī” de.
key_sentences.en: Everyone who has been to Xinjiang mentions the food.

body.zh: 分母 + 分之 + 分子
body.en: denominator (bottom) + 分之 + numerator (top) — the bottom number comes first!
one half
two thirds
one percent
sixty percent
“A makes up … of B” = A 占 B 的 …: 新疆的少数民族占人口总数的百分之六十. ✓ 百分之九十以上 (over 90%), ✗ 九十百分之; ✓ 三分之二 (2/3), ✗ 二分之三 (that's 3/2).

body.zh: 副词“凡是”有“所有”的意思，表示在某个范围中无一例外。在“凡是……，（都）……”结构中，“凡是”的后边一般是名词短语。例如：
body.en: The adverb “凡是” means “all / every”: there's no exception within a certain range. In “凡是……，（都）……”, what follows 凡是 is usually a noun phrase, e.g.,

body.zh: 凡是 + 名词短语（……的人／……的事），都 + ……
body.py: fánshì + míngcí duǎnyǔ (…… de rén / …… de shì), dōu + ……
body.en: every + (noun phrase, usually ending in 的 + noun), 都 + …

body.zh: 凡是认识她的人，都说她漂亮。
body.py: Fánshì rènshi tā de rén, dōu shuō tā piàoliang.
body.en: Everyone who knows her says she's beautiful.

body.zh: 凡是应该做的事，都要努力做好。
body.py: Fánshì yīnggāi zuò de shì, dōu yào nǔlì zuòhǎo.
body.en: Everything that should be done must be done well.
After 凡是 you need a noun phrase, so keep the 的 + noun: ✓ 凡是他写的书 / ✓ 凡是去过那儿的人. ✗ 凡是他写书 / ✗ 凡是去过那儿，…

body.zh: 双重否定表示肯定，有时表示强调。常见的形式有“没有不……”“没有……不……”“没有……没有……”“不……不……”等。例如：
body.en: A double negative expresses a positive, sometimes with emphasis. Common forms: “没有不……”, “没有……不……”, “没有……没有……”, “不……不……”, e.g.,

body.zh: 那个电影非常有名，没有人不知道。
body.py: Nàge diànyǐng fēicháng yǒumíng, méiyǒu rén bù zhīdào.
body.en: That film is very famous — there's no one who doesn't know it.

body.zh: 凡是听过她的歌的人，没有不喜欢的。
body.py: Fánshì tīngguo tā de gē de rén, méiyǒu bù xǐhuan de.
body.en: Everyone who's heard her songs loves them.

body.zh: A. ……没有不……的　B. 没有……不……　C. 没有／不……就没有／不……　D. 不……不行
body.py: A. …… méiyǒu bù…… de · B. méiyǒu…… bù…… · C. méiyǒu / bù…… jiù méiyǒu / bù…… · D. bù…… bùxíng
body.en: A. none who don't… · B. there's no… that doesn't… · C. without… you can't… · D. you must… (not … won't do)

body.py: Zhège gē méiyǒu bú huì chàng de.
body.en: Everyone can sing this song. (A)

body.zh: 成龙非常有名，在中国没有人不知道他。
body.py: Chéng Lóng fēicháng yǒumíng, zài Zhōngguó méiyǒu rén bù zhīdào tā.
body.en: Jackie Chan is very famous — everyone in China knows him. (B)

body.py: Méiyǒu hùzhào jiù bù néng chū guó.
body.en: Without a passport you can't go abroad. (C)

body.zh: 想获得冠军，不努力不行。
body.py: Xiǎng huòdé guànjūn, bù nǔlì bùxíng.
body.en: If you want to win, you have to work hard. (D)
Both negatives are needed for the positive meaning: ✓ 还没有不喜欢她做的菜的 (everyone likes it). Dropping one (✗ 还没有喜欢她做的菜的) means nobody likes it.

title.en: What percentage does it account for?

instructions.zh: 模仿例句，根据所给信息问答。
instructions.en: Ask and answer using the information, following the example.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 新疆的少数民族占人口总数的多大比例？
lines.py: Xīnjiāng de shǎoshù mínzú zhàn rénkǒu zǒngshù de duō dà bǐlì?
lines.en: What proportion of Xinjiang's population are ethnic minorities?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 新疆的少数民族占人口总数的60%。
lines.py: Xīnjiāng de shǎoshù mínzú zhàn rénkǒu zǒngshù de bǎi fēn zhī liùshí.
lines.en: Ethnic minorities make up 60% of the population.

prompt.zh: 新疆面积：166万平方公里　中国面积：960万平方公里
prompt.py: Xīnjiāng miànjī: yì bǎi liùshíliù wàn píngfāng gōnglǐ · Zhōngguó miànjī: jiǔ bǎi liùshí wàn píngfāng gōnglǐ
prompt.en: Area of Xinjiang: 1.66 million km² · Area of China: 9.6 million km²

answer.zh: 新疆的面积大约占中国面积的六分之一。
answer.py: Xīnjiāng de miànjī dàyuē zhàn Zhōngguó miànjī de liù fēn zhī yī.
answer.en: Xinjiang is about one sixth of China's area (≈17%).

prompt.zh: 中国人口：13.6亿　世界人口：72.2亿（2014年）
prompt.py: Zhōngguó rénkǒu: shísān diǎn liù yì · shìjiè rénkǒu: qīshí'èr diǎn èr yì (èr líng yī sì nián)
prompt.en: Population of China: 1.36 billion · World: 7.22 billion (2014)

answer.zh: 中国人口大约占世界人口的五分之一。
answer.py: Zhōngguó rénkǒu dàyuē zhàn shìjiè rénkǒu de wǔ fēn zhī yī.
answer.en: China has about one fifth of the world's population (≈19%).

prompt.zh: 维吾尔族人口：1000万　新疆人口总数：2200万（2014年）
prompt.py: Wéiwú'ěrzú rénkǒu: yì qiān wàn · Xīnjiāng rénkǒu zǒngshù: liǎng qiān èr bǎi wàn (èr líng yī sì nián)
prompt.en: Uyghur population: 10 million · Total population of Xinjiang: 22 million (2014)

answer.zh: 维吾尔族人口大约占新疆人口总数的百分之四十五。
answer.py: Wéiwú'ěrzú rénkǒu dàyuē zhàn Xīnjiāng rénkǒu zǒngshù de bǎi fēn zhī sìshíwǔ.
answer.en: Uyghurs make up about 45% of Xinjiang's population.

prompt.zh: 选择你感兴趣的问题在班里展开调查，然后汇报你的调查结果。
prompt.en: Class activity: survey classmates (e.g. 见过草原 seen grassland / 去过沙漠 been to a desert / 参加过环保活动 joined an environmental activity / 对历史感兴趣 interested in history) and report the ratio. Book's example: 我调查了8位同学，爱吃葡萄的占3/4。

answer.zh: 我调查了8位同学，爱吃葡萄的占四分之三。
answer.py: Wǒ diàochále bā wèi tóngxué, ài chī pútao de zhàn sì fēn zhī sān.
answer.en: I surveyed 8 classmates; three quarters love grapes. (book's example)

answer.zh: 我调查了10位同学，去过沙漠的占十分之三。
answer.py: Wǒ diàochále shí wèi tóngxué, qùguo shāmò de zhàn shí fēn zhī sān.
answer.en: I surveyed 10 classmates; three tenths have been to a desert. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 先用“凡是”描述下列各图，然后根据实际情况完成句子。
instructions.en: Describe each picture with “凡是”, then complete the sentences about yourself.

body.zh: 凡是去过新疆的人，都说那儿风景美得不得了。
body.py: Fánshì qùguo Xīnjiāng de rén, dōu shuō nàr fēngjǐng měi de bùdéliǎo.
body.en: Everyone who's been to Xinjiang says the scenery is stunning.

items.picture: A packed rock concert with stage lights and a cheering crowd.

answer.zh: 凡是去过那个演唱会的人，都说太精彩了。
answer.py: Fánshì qùguo nàge yǎnchànghuì de rén, dōu shuō tài jīngcǎi le.
answer.en: Everyone who went to that concert says it was fantastic. (model answer)

items.picture: A circle of laughing friends cheering together.

answer.zh: 凡是参加聚会的人，都玩儿得很开心。
answer.py: Fánshì cānjiā jùhuì de rén, dōu wánr de hěn kāixīn.
answer.en: Everyone at the party had a great time. (model answer)

items.picture: A basket overflowing with fresh vegetables and fruit.

answer.zh: 凡是新鲜的蔬菜水果，我都爱吃。
answer.en: I love all fresh fruit and vegetables. (model answer)

items.picture: People in a cinema watching a film.

answer.zh: 凡是好看的电影，我都喜欢看。
answer.en: I like watching any good film. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 凡是老师要求大家做的，______。
prompt.py: Fánshì lǎoshī yāoqiú dàjiā zuò de, ______.
prompt.en: Everything the teacher asks us to do, …

answer.zh: 凡是老师要求大家做的，我们都要认真做好。
凡是你不懂的，都可以问我。
凡是中国电影，我都喜欢。
answer.en: I like every Chinese film. (model answer)

answer.py: Fánshì là de cài, wǒ dōu ài chī.
answer.en: I love every spicy dish. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 模仿例句造句。你们的朋友暗恋一个漂亮的女孩，请用双重否定句给他一些建议，说得越多越好。
instructions.en: Make sentences following patterns A–D (see grammar note 3). Then: your friend has a secret crush on a beautiful girl — give him as much advice as you can using double negatives.

body.zh: 我觉得你可以送她花，没有女孩子不喜欢花。
body.py: Wǒ juéde nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā huā, méiyǒu nǚ háizi bù xǐhuan huā.
body.en: I think you could give her flowers — there's no girl who doesn't like flowers.

answer.zh: 这家饭馆的菜，我们班的同学没有不喜欢的。
answer.en: Everyone in our class loves this restaurant's food. (model answer)

answer.zh: 在我们学校，没有人不认识他。
answer.en: Everyone at our school knows him. (model answer)

prompt.en: Pattern C: 没有／不……就没有／不……

answer.zh: 不学汉字就不能看中文书。
answer.py: Bù xué Hànzì jiù bù néng kàn Zhōngwén shū.
answer.en: If you don't learn characters, you can't read Chinese books. (model answer)

answer.zh: 明天要考试，今天不复习不行。
answer.en: There's an exam tomorrow — I have to revise today. (model answer)

prompt.en: Advice for your friend with a crush

answer.zh: 你得告诉她，不说不行。没有女孩子不喜欢真心的人。
answer.py: Nǐ děi gàosu tā, bù shuō bùxíng. Méiyǒu nǚ háizi bù xǐhuan zhēnxīn de rén.
answer.en: You've got to tell her — not saying anything won't do. There's no girl who doesn't like someone sincere. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 中国百分之九十以上是汉族人。
options.py: Zhōngguó bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí yǐshàng shì Hànzú rén.

options.zh: 中国九十百分之以上是汉族人。
options.py: Zhōngguó jiǔshí bǎi fēn zhī yǐshàng shì Hànzú rén.
Fánshì tā xiě shū, wǒ dōu kànguo.

options.zh: 凡是他写的书，我都看过。
options.py: Fánshì tā xiě de shū, wǒ dōu kànguo.

questions.explain: 凡是 needs a noun phrase: 他写的书. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 我们班女同学占三分之二。
options.py: Wǒmen bān nǚ tóngxué zhàn sān fēn zhī èr.

options.zh: 我们班女同学占二分之三。
options.py: Wǒmen bān nǚ tóngxué zhàn èr fēn zhī sān.

questions.explain: Denominator first: 三分之二 = 2/3. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 凡是去过那儿的人，都说那儿的风景很美。
options.py: Fánshì qùguo nàr de rén, dōu shuō nàr de fēngjǐng hěn měi.

options.zh: 凡是去过那儿，都说那儿的风景很美。
options.py: Fánshì qùguo nàr, dōu shuō nàr de fēngjǐng hěn měi.

questions.explain: 凡是 + noun phrase (……的人). (grammar note 2)

question.py: Tā zuò cài zuò de zhēn hǎo!

options.zh: 是啊。我认识的人里，还没有不喜欢她做的菜的。
options.py: Shì a. Wǒ rènshi de rén li, hái méiyǒu bù xǐhuan tā zuò de cài de.

options.zh: 是啊。我认识的人里，还没有喜欢她做的菜的。
options.py: Shì a. Wǒ rènshi de rén li, hái méiyǒu xǐhuan tā zuò de cài de.

questions.explain: Agreeing needs a positive meaning: two negatives (没有不喜欢) = everyone likes it. (grammar note 3)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q5 — review double negatives (note 3). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review fractions (note 1). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review 凡是 (note 2).
